notes: The 'his' of 'his mighty army' is added: the Hebrew writes בְחַיִל גָּדוֹל with no suffix or other possessive morpheme (rule 18, last sentence).
The waw and לֹא fuse to 'Neither' headed on the negative (rule 35), and the bracketed assimilated article of בַּמִּלְחָמָה takes the written 'the' (rule 12).
